description: Lists the states Empath Legal publishes venue facts for. With a state code, lists that state's counties with population, income, unemployment and political lean. Use this when the user asks which venues are covered or wants an overview of a state's counties. Not for case, juror or client data, and not legal advice: it returns published venue facts only.

inputSchema.description: An optional state code; without it the tool lists the states.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. 'la'. Omit to list every state.
state.title: State
